comment: The phrase “minimum viable foundation” may encourage countries to treat the listed components as a universal package, although needs and dependencies differ considerably by selected use case and national context.

public.text: The phrase “minimum viable foundation” may encourage countries to treat the listed components as a universal package, although needs and dependencies differ considerably by selected use case and national context.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a phrase like “minimum viable foundation for the selected national priorities,” and identify a small universal baseline separately from use-case-dependent components.
